workflows.title: A project from lead to delivery
workflows.intro: Each hand-over is automatic and the next team is notified.
workflows.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  L([Lead]):::sales --> P[Sales creates the project]:::sales
  P --> A{Accounts approves the advance?}:::acc
  A -- yes --> M[Project manager assigns a coordinator and gives each department a budget]:::pmo
  A -- not yet --> W[Work tabs stay locked]:::lock
  M --> C[Coordinator accepts and plans]:::pmo
  C --> D[Design pages, UX and Dev sprints]:::work
  D --> Q[QA tests each finished task]:::work
  Q --> G([Go live, AMC and feedback]):::later
  classDef sales fill:#d7ece9,stroke:#0f766e,color:#0b2a27
  classDef acc fill:#fde9c4,stroke:#b7791f,color:#3b2606
  classDef pmo fill:#dfe5f7,stroke:#4c5fb0,color:#13193b
  classDef work fill:#e6f4d9,stroke:#4d8a1d,color:#17300a
  classDef lock fill:#fbdcd8,stroke:#b42318,color:#4a0f0a
  classDef later fill:#e8ecee,stroke:#667781,color:#1d272c

workflows.title: Sprint approval and the QA loop
workflows.intro: The team lead plans, the project manager checks the budget, QA tests, and a failed task goes back to its developer.
workflows.mermaid:
flowchart TD
  T[Team lead plans a sprint with effort and cost]:::a --> S[Submit]:::a
  S --> D{Project manager decides}:::b
  D -- reject with a reason --> T
  D -- approve within budget --> R[Coordinator requests dates]:::b
  R --> SC[Team lead schedules and assigns]:::a
  SC --> W[Developer works and logs days spent]:::c
  W --> F[Task completed]:::c
  F --> QA{QA review}:::d
  QA -- bugs found --> W
  QA -- passed --> V[Team lead verifies and approves]:::a
  V --> E([Sprint complete]):::e
  classDef a fill:#d7ece9,stroke:#0f766e,color:#0b2a27
  classDef b fill:#dfe5f7,stroke:#4c5fb0,color:#13193b
  classDef c fill:#e6f4d9,stroke:#4d8a1d,color:#17300a
  classDef d fill:#fde9c4,stroke:#b7791f,color:#3b2606
  classDef e fill:#e8ecee,stroke:#667781,color:#1d272c

workflows.title: A design page from start to approval
workflows.intro: Every move is logged with who made it and why.
workflows.mermaid:
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> Pending
  Pending --> Ongoing
  Ongoing --> Completed
  Completed --> InternalRevision: internal review (up to 3 times)
  InternalRevision --> Completed
  Completed --> WaitingForFeedback: sent to the client
  WaitingForFeedback --> Correction: client asks for changes (up to 3 times)
  Correction --> Completed
  WaitingForFeedback --> Rejected: needs a reason
  WaitingForFeedback --> [*]: approved
